name: Evaluation unit trial review
summary: When a customer's evaluation reaches its review milestone, the account engineer and account owner get a trial-review agenda that sets the agreed use case beside the recorded results, setup changes and feedback, with every gap turned into a question and next-step options.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of how a hardware company brings a customer evaluation back to the use case agreed at the start: the agreed criteria, the recorded results, the setup as it was run, the customer's feedback and the support history, each with set column headers; every result labelled by where it was run; every gap turned into a question for the person who can answer it.
